body: JetBlue withdrew four international destinations during 2026, ending flights to Antigua, Belize City, Bonaire and Tulum, all previously served from New York JFK (JFK). Bonaire ended in January, Tulum in March, Belize City in May and Antigua in September, with Antigua's route dating back to 2015 while the others launched in 2023 or 2024. At the same time, JetBlue added four international destinations in 2026 and saw Fort Lauderdale overtake JFK as its busiest airport, averaging 133 daily departures against 127 at JFK in the current winter schedule.

Sun Country stopped serving 25 destinations, mostly from its Minneapolis hub, with most last flights in August or September, and exited the Canadian market entirely after its last flights to Vancouver in August and Toronto in September. WestJet cut 15 destinations, including a complete exit from Cuba covering seven destinations, alongside cuts such as Halifax to Copenhagen and Madrid and Toronto to Glasgow. Alaska Airlines, by contrast, saw no airport cease service in 2026, according to schedule analysis; its three airport removals, Dallas Love, Nassau and Monterrey, all took place in 2025.

The four cases point in different directions rather than a single industry trend. JetBlue framed its changes as redeploying capacity toward Fort Lauderdale, where it reports its best financial returns, while Sun Country's winter schedule is down about 11.5% in flights and seats compared with 2025, according to Cirium data cited in the report. WestJet concentrated capacity back on domestic Canadian routes, and Alaska's network kept growing in October 2026, with Seattle remaining its most-served airport.
en.summary: JetBlue dropped four international destinations in 2026, Sun Country cut 25 destinations and exited Canada, and WestJet cut 15 destinations including all of Cuba, while Alaska Airlines removed no airport in 2026 after three removals in 2025.
en.title: JetBlue, Sun Country and WestJet cut destinations while Alaska holds its 2026 network

body: JetBlue於2026年撤出4個國際航點，包括安地卡、貝里斯市、波奈及土倫，4條航線過去皆由紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）出發。波奈於1月結束、土倫於3月結束、貝里斯市於5月結束、安地卡於9月結束，其中安地卡航線自2015年起營運，其餘航線則於2023年或2024年開航。同一期間，JetBlue新增4個國際航點，羅德岱堡堡也超越甘迺迪機場成為其最繁忙機場，本季冬季班表平均每日133班，高於甘迺迪機場的127班。

Sun Country停飛25個航點，多數由明尼阿波利斯樞紐出發，末班多落在8月或9月，並在8月飛往溫哥華、9月飛往多倫多的末班之後完全退出加拿大市場。WestJet削減15個航點，包括完全退出古巴的7個航點，以及哈利法克斯往哥本哈根與馬德里、多倫多往格拉斯哥等航線。相較之下，Alaska航空在2026年沒有任何機場停止服務，其3個機場撤出皆發生於2025年，分別為5月的達拉斯愛田、8月的拿索與10月的蒙特雷。
4家航空公司的走向並不一致，並非單一產業趨勢。JetBlue把運能重新部署至財務表現最佳的羅德岱堡堡，Sun Country本年度航班與座位數較2025年減少約11.5%，WestJet則把運能集中回加拿大國內航線，而Alaska航空2026年10月的運量仍在成長，西雅圖仍是其服務最多的機場。
zh.summary: JetBlue於2026年撤出4個國際航點，Sun Country削減25個航點並退出加拿大市場，WestJet削減15個航點並完全退出古巴；Alaska航空則在2026年未再撤出機場，其3次撤出皆發生於2025年。
zh.title: JetBlue、Sun Country與WestJet相繼削減航點、Alaska則在2026年未再撤出機場
